measurement: One sequential pass. First request per dataset opens a new inference connection; provider warmth is unknown. Timings are client EDIT_INFER to SQL and SQL execution, not rendering or photons. Database result cache, rollups and compression disabled. No speculative requests.

base.originalQuestion: Hourly average wind for each vessel
base.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '60 minutes', ts) AS bucket, vessel, avg(wind) AS wind FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-10 06:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-10 12:00:00' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

base.originalQuestion: Average departure delay by airline for non-cancelled flights from JFK since June 24, 2024
base.sql: SELECT c.name AS airline, avg(f.dep_delay) AS delay FROM flights f JOIN carriers c ON f.carrier = c.code WHERE f.origin = 'JFK' AND f.flight_date >= DATE '2024-06-24' AND NOT f.cancelled AND f.dep_delay > 0 GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name
